Build test scenarios with configurable object generation.

The scenario builder uses a builder pattern to generate test data:
  - Specify object kinds to generate
  - Set counts per kind or use defaults
  - Control diversity (field variation)
  - Create relationships between objects
  - Distribute objects across time ranges

  Generate 100 backlog items with default diversity
  zqk utility scenario-builder --target test-scenarios/my-test --kinds backlog_item --count backlog_item=100
  Generate diverse test data
  zqk utility scenario-builder --target test-scenarios/my-test --kinds backlog_item goal milestone --count backlog_item=500,goal=50,milestone=20 --diversity backlog_item=8,goal=5,milestone=3
  Generate with relationships
  zqk utility scenario-builder --target test-scenarios/my-test --kinds backlog_item goal --link-probability 0.5

Usage:
  zqk utility scenario-builder [flags]

Flags:
      --change-policy string            Policy for handling objects that change during snapshot: reject (skip), include (use current), reconstruct (from change journal) (default "include")
      --columns string                  Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
      --count stringToString            Count per kind (e.g., backlog_item=100,goal=50) (default [])
      --data-file string                Path to YAML file containing object data to load (alternative to --kinds)
      --default-count int               Default count for kinds not specified in --count (default 100)
      --default-diversity int           Default diversity level (1-10) (default 5)
      --diversity stringToString        Diversity level per kind 1-10 (e.g., backlog_item=8,goal=5) (default [])
      --dry-run                         Show what would be generated without creating objects
      --field-override stringToString   Field value overrides (e.g., status=proposed) (default [])
      --force                           Force overwrite existing objects (update instead of skip on duplicate)
  -f, --format string                   Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link) (default "table")
      --id-prefix-override string       ID prefix override for copied objects (e.g., TEST-) (default "TEST-")
      --ignore-scheduler-down           Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
      --kinds strings                   Object kinds to generate (e.g., backlog_item,goal,milestone)
      --link-probability float          Probability of creating links between objects (0.0-1.0) (default 0.3)
      --namespace-override string       Namespace override for copied objects (default "test:scenario")
      --object-ids strings              Object IDs to copy from main project (alternative to --kinds)
  -o, --output string                   Write output to file
      --preserve-state                  Preserve object state (status, timestamps) when copying
  -q, --quiet                           Suppress non-essential output
      --scenario-id string              Load configuration from scenario object ID (alternative to --kinds)
      --source-project string           Source project root (defaults to main project root)
      --target string                   Target scenario directory (required)
      --time-range duration             Time range for created_at timestamps (default 720h0m0s)
      --timeout duration                Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose                         Verbose output
